title: A Provision for the Rivergate
author: Rafael Okafor
blurb: Emrys Vasquez, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
